message: Yuuki's ability to stop time and simultaneously use a powerful spell seems incongruent with previously established rules of magic where simultaneous complex spellcasting is not feasible.

evidence.description: ‘Tidak mungkin bagi Yuuki untuk mengaktifkan Chrono Saltation sendiri.’

message: The transition of characters like Milim and Ramiris from a state of despair to suddenly gaining determination to fight lacks sufficient buildup, making it feel abrupt.

evidence.description: ‘Rimuru adalah… Rimuru telah menghilang…’ dan kemudian ‘Ya, kamu benar sekali. Ayo lakukan ini, Ramiris!’
